# oioi.bio

> oioi.bio is an AI narrative filmmaking workspace for turning ideas and novels into scripts, reusable visual assets, storyboards, and generated video.

## Core capabilities

- Import source material from TXT, DOCX, EPUB, and PDF.
- Develop narration or animated-drama scripts.
- Manage reusable characters, locations, props, and visual references.
- Turn scenes into structured shots, storyboard images, and generated video.
- Connect multiple text, image, and video model providers.
- Track generation tasks, versions, estimated cost, and actual usage.
